A direct quotient/rank argument proves rank D=r+h+k. The proof treats all d≥2 and all prime powers, with no reliance on finite enumeration. Fully exhaustive d=2 checks at q=2 and q=3, all compatible Q for canonical rank-one P at d=3 q=2, and normalization across d≤5 are corroborations. The formula proves the global case symbolically.
